title: Plan for Oswald to fire a deliberate miss at the motorcade and blame Cuba

tellings.quote: what what the the plan was is to coax him into taking a shot at the motorcade, not hitting anybody, but taking a shot at the motorcade.

related.note: Both tell Sheehan's account of the plan for Oswald's shot and Tippit's role. Here Oswald shoots at Kennedy, while the story has a deliberate miss to blame Cuba.

plain: The plan in Dallas in 1963, according to a researcher named Dan Sheehan, was to coax Lee Harvey Oswald, the man later accused of killing President Kennedy, into taking a shot at the president's motorcade without hitting anybody, so the attack could be blamed on Cuba. Sheehan tells this without naming a source and connects it to the later killing of a Dallas police officer named J. D. Tippit. If true, it would mean the shooting began as a staged provocation that went further than planned.
